description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class which encapsulates configuration options for JWT token issuance, including claims and cryptographic credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating options and properties for configuring JWT token issuance, including claims like issuer, subject, audience, and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property that provides a function to generate a unique JWT ID (JTI) using GUID.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A property that returns the expiration DateTime for the token based on IssuedAt and ValidFor.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A property that returns the current UTC time indicating when the token was issued.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property that returns the current UTC time indicating when the token becomes valid.
